model: Placement / pins / port spans: exactly a2f_hub_faces.py (build_split4 -> arrange -> spans_from_plan -> install_spans, optional hop1).  Every bit connection is a register-to-register hop (every VM leaf registers its pins); a hop of length L needs ceil(L / R) - 1 relay registers and a hop class pays its longest bit.  Leaf-to-leaf hop lengths are pin-to-pin Manhattan lengths of shared nets (driver -> farthest sink), NOT the Prim-tree chaining of the VM.RELAY ledger basis.
